BiblicalUsage: The word appears once, in the law that bars a man who is mutilated from entering the congregation of the Lord. It is a hard verse about wholeness and the assembly.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the law guarded the holiness of the gathered people, and Christ has since opened the assembly to all who come to Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
